name: Cross with Friends
description: Reads crossword games without hidden solutions and operates shared answers, checks, reveals, chat and resets with state guards and server confirmation.

tools.name: get_game_state
tools.description: Read current entered cells, clues, game metadata, players, timer, selection and recent chat; never return hidden solutions.

tools.name: set_answer
tools.description: Enter a clue answer with crossing conflict protection and server confirmation.

tools.name: clear_answer
tools.description: Clear editable letters of a clue, including shared crossings.

tools.name: focus_clue
tools.description: Select a clue in the local UI without broadcasting a cursor or changing game data.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Apply the site's shared correctness marks to a cell, clue or puzzle.

tools.name: reveal
tools.description: Reveal a cell, clue or puzzle for all players after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.description: Send a confirmed, non-retractable message to the multiplayer chat.

tools.name: reset_game
tools.description: Reset the unsolved puzzle for all players after explicit confirmation; preserve the timer.
